statusDefinitions.gap: No suitable primary measured evidence has yet been retained.
statusDefinitions.provisional: Useful evidence candidates exist, but publisher verification and/or independent measured confirmation is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.promoted: At least two independent publisher-verified primary measured studies satisfy the promotion rule.

mechanisms.title: Ejection and demoulding physics
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Release load can change with temperature, shrinkage, draft, texture, adhesion and mould condition; simply increasing eject force can hide the mechanism or damage tooling.
desiredEvidence: physical part quality or damage outcome

sources.title: The Effect of Processing Parameters and Calcium-stearate on the Ejection Process of Injection Molded Poly(Lactic Acid) Products
Self-Assembled Monolayers of Alkanethiols on Nickel Insert: Characterization of Friction and Analysis on Demolding Quality in Microinjection Molding
Adhesion-Induced Demolding Forces of Hard Coated Microstructures Measured with a Novel Injection Molding Tool
Coefficient of friction in the demoulding forces of the injection moulding process—a review

mechanisms.limitation: PLA, microstructured inserts, coatings and the tested tool geometries are application-specific; the promoted mechanism does not create universal eject-force, lubricant, coating, draft-angle or process limits.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Map the promoted evidence to S11/ejector-drag learning and test whether authorised site or public data contain suitable release-force, thermal and physical-quality signals.

mechanisms.title: Residual stress and birefringence
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Residual stress can remain when appearance and dimensions look acceptable and is especially important in optical, precision and chemically sensitive parts.

sources.title: Correlation Between In-Mold Pressure and Residual Stress in Cyclo-Olefin Copolymer Injection Molding Using Birefringence Analysis
Study of the Effects of Mold Coating on the Birefringence of Injection-Molded Optical-Quality Polycarbonate
Residual stress measurement for injection molded components
Effects of Thermal Molding Conditions on the Residual Stress and Residual Birefringence in an Injection-Molded Polymer Strip

mechanisms.limitation: COC and optical polycarbonate studies, sensor locations, mould coatings and lens geometries are application-specific; promotion supports the mechanism but no tested pressure, coating, temperature, speed or timing becomes universal guidance.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Use the promoted evidence in S13 and precision-optics learning while seeking public/site data with independent optical stress, pressure and dimensional outcomes.

mechanisms.title: Weld-line mechanical strength versus appearance
mechanisms.whyItMatters: A visually acceptable weld line can still be mechanically weak, while an obvious line is not automatically the highest structural risk.

sources.title: Investigation the effects of obstacle geometries and injection molding parameters on weld line strength using experimental and finite element methods in plastic injection molding
On the assessment of strength and durability of weld lines in injection-moulded unreinforced and short glass fiber reinforced polypropylene
Comparative study of weld-line strength for unfilled and glass-filled thermoplastic polyamide-6 materials
A review of research progress on the minimization of weld lines in injection molding

mechanisms.limitation: Polypropylene and polyamide studies, reinforcement levels, weld geometries and loading programmes are application-specific; promotion supports the structural mechanism but creates no universal weld-line strength reduction, process setting or acceptance limit.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Use the promoted evidence in S14 while keeping cosmetic visibility separate from structural qualification, and seek shot-linked mechanical outcomes in authorised validation data where available.

mechanisms.title: Fibre breakage and retained fibre length
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Fibre orientation alone does not describe reinforced-part behaviour; processing can shorten fibres and change stiffness, strength and anisotropy.

sources.title: Relation between injection molding conditions, fiber length and mechanical properties for highly reinforced long fiber polypropylene
The Low Breaking Fiber Mechanism and Its Effect on the Behavior of the Melt Flow of Injection Molded Ultra-Long Glass Fiber Reinforced Polypropylene Composites
Influence of fiber breakage on flow behavior in fiber length- and orientation-dependent injection molding simulations

mechanisms.limitation: Fibre damage depends on feedstock architecture, fibre type/length, screw/nozzle/tool geometry and processing history.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify at least two studies with measured retained fibre length and measured physical outcomes before promotion.

mechanisms.title: Runner, gate and multicavity imbalance
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Global machine averages can conceal cavity-specific imbalance caused by runner geometry, viscosity, gate condition or local thermal behaviour.

sources.title: Simulation Studies on the Effect of Material Characteristics and Runners Layout Geometry on the Filling Imbalance in Geometrically Balanced Injection Molds
Impact of Runner Size, Gate Size, Polymer Viscosity, and Molding Process on Filling Imbalance in Geometrically Balanced Multi-Cavity Injection Molding
Study on the Influence of Runner and Overflow Area Design on Flow–Fiber Coupling in a Multi-Cavity System

mechanisms.limitation: Balance response is mould-, cavity-, runner-, gate- and material-specific; a geometrically balanced layout is not proof of rheological balance.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify multicavity measured studies and preserve cavity identity in public/site-data validation and learning examples.

mechanisms.title: Hot-runner actual thermal and mechanical behaviour
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Displayed zone temperature or commanded valve timing may not equal actual thermal/mechanical response at the manifold, nozzle, gate or cavity.

sources.title: Out-of-Mold Sensor-Based Process Parameter Optimization and Adaptive Process Quality Control for Hot Runner Thin-Walled Injection-Molded Parts
Numerical Simulation of Deformation in Hot Runner Manifold
Mechanical and crystallization properties of hot runner injection molded virgin and recycled polypropylene

mechanisms.limitation: Hot-runner response depends on system design, controller, manifold/nozzle architecture, material and tool thermal state.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify measured hot-runner studies with independent actuals rather than displayed setpoints alone.

mechanisms.title: Liquid silicone rubber cure and crosslinking behaviour
mechanisms.whyItMatters: LSR uses thermoset cure/crosslinking behaviour and hot mould conditions that must not be taught as ordinary thermoplastic injection moulding.

sources.title: Novel approach to characterize the cross-linking effect of liquid silicone rubber via cavity pressure analysis during injection molding
Effects of Variation in Process Parameters on Cavity Pressure and Mechanical Strength of Molded Parts in LSR Injection Molding
Liquid Silicone Rubber Headlamp Lens Injection Molding Process Optimization Based on Tie Bar Elongation and NSGA III

mechanisms.limitation: LSR formulations, cure systems, mould temperatures and optical/medical requirements are application-specific.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Publisher-verify cure/cavity-pressure studies and retain LSR as a separate specialist process family.

mechanisms.title: Gas, water and projectile-assisted moulding
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Fluid penetration, residual wall thickness and void formation introduce mechanisms that do not exist in conventional solid-part filling.

sources.title: Study of Residual Wall Thickness and Multiobjective Optimization for Process Parameters of Water-Assisted Injection Molding
Experimental and Numerical Investigation of the Effect of Process Conditions on Residual Wall Thickness and Cooling and Surface Characteristics of Water-Assisted Injection Molded Hollow Products
A Study on the Void Formation in Residual Wall Thickness of Fluid-Assisted Injection Molding Parts
Effects of Processing Method and Parameters on the Wall Thickness of Gas-Projectile-Assisted Injection Molding Pipes

mechanisms.limitation: Water-, gas- and projectile-assisted processes have different equipment and penetration physics and must not be collapsed into one recipe.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify representative measured studies for each assisted-process family before any mechanism promotion.

mechanisms.title: Moisture, drying and process-induced degradation
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Dryer setpoint is not material moisture at point of use; hydrolysis and excessive thermal/shear history can alter rheology and properties while machine settings appear unchanged.

sources.title: An Investigation to Reduce the Effect of Moisture on Injection-Molded Parts through Optimization of Plasticization Parameters
Study of the Influence of the Reprocessing Cycles on the Final Properties of Polylactide Pieces Obtained by Injection Molding
Considerations on the Drying of the Raw Material and Consequences on the Quality of the Injected Products

mechanisms.limitation: Moisture sensitivity, safe drying conditions and degradation mechanisms are resin/grade specific; supplier data and approved procedures control real processing limits.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Prioritize studies with independently measured water content and physical property/process outcomes, not dryer settings alone.

mechanisms.title: Recyclate and process variability
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Recycled feedstock can vary in composition, degradation, rheology and contamination; nominal grade or one MFR value does not establish equivalent moulding response.
desiredEvidence: part mass, dimension, mechanical or quality outcome

sources.title: Inline pvT Analysis for Precise Volume Dosing in Injection Molding: Addressing Variability in Recyclate Melts
Processing behavior evolution of recycled polypropylene: An integrated experimental and Computer-Aided engineering simulation study
Mechanical and crystallization properties of hot runner injection molded virgin and recycled polypropylene

mechanisms.limitation: Recyclate response depends on feedstock stream, contamination, stabilisation, prior life, blend fraction and process history.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Use the existing RWTH PCR public dataset as the first executable validation lane and verify literature relationships against measured process and part-mass data.

mechanisms.title: Surface replication, texture, adhesion and release
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Surface quality and microfeature fidelity couple filling, mould temperature, texture, adhesion and demoulding rather than belonging to a single machine setting.

sources.title: Self-Assembled Monolayers of Alkanethiols on Nickel Insert: Characterization of Friction and Analysis on Demolding Quality in Microinjection Molding
Geometric Replication Integrity of Micro Features Fabricated Using Variotherm Assisted Micro Injection Moulding
Considering microtexture geometry to improve micro-injection molding fidelity

mechanisms.limitation: Micro/nano replication and release behaviour is feature-, tool-surface-, polymer- and thermal-cycle-specific.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify measured replication/release studies and keep surface fidelity and release as related but separable outcomes.

mechanisms.title: Injection-compression and precision optical moulding
mechanisms.whyItMatters: Precision optics expose the interaction between fill/compression history, thermal control, residual stress, birefringence and geometric replication.

sources.title: Manufacturing Signatures of Injection Molding and Injection Compression Molding for Micro-Structured Polymer Fresnel Lens Production
Investigation of Molding Characteristics in Injection Compression Molding According to Molding Conditions through Birefringence
Fabrication of the low-residual-stress optical microstructure by using the simulation and practice strategies, in-mold induction heating system, and injection compression molding technology

mechanisms.limitation: Optical-grade resins, lens geometry, compression strategy and metrology are highly application-specific.
mechanisms.nextValidation: Verify independent measured optics/ICM studies and preserve material, tool and metrology context.
